projections.name: Tradeable correction first (the C-leg)
projections.why: A-B-C completes at C=A (~7,170) or 1.618×A (~6,920), holds the 200dma shelf, melt-up case gets one more leg. Wolf Pack's 6,500 flush into November is the deep version.

projections.name: Melt-up resumes (1999 analog)
projections.why: Fed stays paused, AI earnings deliver, rotation broadens past 7,610 with RSP/SPY rising. Analog pays +16%; conditional median +12.5%. The upside scenario, not the default.

projections.name: Choppy range
projections.why: Long end pins the multiple; distribution-vs-consolidation stays unresolved under a flat index. The 1994-inside-a-bull outcome.

projections.name: Bust begins (Big_Nuts roadmap)
projections.why: Wave-5 top at 760.40 SPY confirmed: 10Y through 4.94–5.05, OAS >340bp, breadth rolls, AI capex guides down. Shelves 6,841 → 6,391 → 5,680 (−25% from ATH).

projections.name: Right-tail mania
projections.why: 1999-Q4-style blowoff, +20% in months. Hasn't happened from a negative-ERP start.

watchlists.title: Turns the melt-up into the top (2000 triggers, 2026 form)
items: Fed re-hikes (2Y already at 4.22 vs 3.63 funds; a July/Sep hike = 2000's tightening-into-strength)
10Y through 4.94–5.05 (cup-and-handle target) or 30Y > 5.5% — the multiple's ceiling; every 2026 air-pocket has been a long-end event
HY OAS > ~340bp — converts the HYG rounding top from a rates story into a credit story
Breadth divergence at a new high — RSP/SPY rolling over while SPX prints ATH (the Mar-2000 signature; today it's doing the opposite)
AI capex guide-downs — MU is now 2% of SPY; hyperscaler capex is the earnings transmission line for 40% of the fund
SPY loses the C=A shelf (~715) and NQ fails to reclaim ~29,500 (diamond apex) — the wave count's confirmation
Disorderly yen strength off the 164 zone (carry unwind) or equity-repo spread widening past +150bp over SOFR — the two forced-deleveraging channels

watchlists.title: Confirms the 1999 leg (adds to melt-up odds)
items: SPX closes above 7,610 with RSP/SPY still rising — broad-participation breakout
Wolf Pack's 6,800 line: their model flips bullish above it "sustainably" — already reclaimed; a Q3 hold converts a bear
VIX back under 16 while realized stays low — hedge premium unwinds into fuel
Fed cuts resume (UMich 49.8 gives them the consumer cover)
IWM/value leg keeps absorbing rotation without index damage — 1998-Q4 signature
MOVE spikes through 130 then reverses — Treasury seizure forces Fed liquidity; historically the rescue, not the top (crash-then-rip)
The C-leg completes at 7,170/6,920 SPX on quiet credit (OAS still <320) — correction proven technical, add zone triggers
